nodes.label: Recognition Accessibility
nodes.definition: Ease with which previously encountered information can be identified as familiar or previously experienced when presented again.
nodes.mechanism_summary: Recognition availability depends on encoding, cue/context match, and memory strength; it is not equivalent to unaided recall.
failure_modes: Do not infer Recognition Accessibility from a single output metric.
Do not treat Recognition Accessibility as a universal copywriting effect without boundary conditions.

nodes.label: Recall Accessibility
nodes.definition: Ease with which previously encoded information can be retrieved without direct re-presentation of the target.
nodes.mechanism_summary: Recall depends on encoding and retrieval cues and should not be used as a complete proxy for comprehension or persuasion.
failure_modes: Do not infer Recall Accessibility from a single output metric.
Do not treat Recall Accessibility as a universal copywriting effect without boundary conditions.

nodes.label: Mind Wandering
nodes.definition: Shift of attention away from the current external task toward internally generated, task-unrelated thought.
nodes.mechanism_summary: Mind wandering can impair task performance but can also support planning/creativity; it is not simply low attention ability.
failure_modes: Do not infer Mind Wandering from a single output metric.
Do not treat Mind Wandering as a universal copywriting effect without boundary conditions.

nodes.label: Alertness
nodes.definition: Readiness state that supports detection and response to relevant events.
nodes.mechanism_summary: Alertness affects attentional performance but is distinguishable from selective attention and sustained attention.
failure_modes: Do not infer Alertness from a single output metric.
Do not treat Alertness as a universal copywriting effect without boundary conditions.

nodes.label: Distractor Suppression
nodes.definition: Reduction of processing priority for competing, task-irrelevant information.
nodes.mechanism_summary: Suppression can be proactive or reactive and should not be inferred simply because distraction was low.
failure_modes: Do not infer Distractor Suppression from a single output metric.
Do not treat Distractor Suppression as a universal copywriting effect without boundary conditions.
open_questions: Needs focused validation/calibration before strong runtime recommendation.

nodes.label: Task Switching

nodes.label: Anticipated Affect

Do not treat Anticipated Affect as a universal copywriting effect without boundary conditions.

Do not treat Anticipatory Pleasure as a universal copywriting effect without boundary conditions.

nodes.label: Effort Mobilization
nodes.definition: Allocation of energetic and cognitive resources in service of goal pursuit when demand and value justify effort.
nodes.mechanism_summary: Effort mobilization depends on perceived demand, value, expectancy, and cost; more effort is not always adaptive.
failure_modes: Do not infer Effort Mobilization from a single output metric.
Do not treat Effort Mobilization as a universal copywriting effect without boundary conditions.

nodes.label: Self-Control

nodes.label: Intrinsic Motivation

nodes.label: Internalization

nodes.mechanism_summary: Internalization varies in degree; extrinsic motivation can become relatively autonomous without becoming intrinsic.

Do not treat Internalization as a universal copywriting effect without boundary conditions.

nodes.label: Obedience to Authority

nodes.label: Power Asymmetry
